headline: Wave of Investment in Old Hotels Targeting Clients with Larger Wallets, Including in Rhodes
summary: A large share of capital placed in the Greek hotel market is going into existing older hotels aimed at higher-spending clients, including on Rhodes, rather than new construction.
why: Hotel investment flows indicate demand and valuations in Greece's tourism sector, which is a major source of foreign currency and growth.
